message.reasoning_content: Kernel: polynomial approximation for |x|<=1.05, log formula otherwise. Tolerance 1e-6 absolute — quite tight. Polynomial coefficients look like a minmax asinh polynomial but likely ~1e-8 error? Actually 8-degree polynomial likely accurate to ~1e-7? Unclear — risk: polynomial error may exceed 1e-6 near threshold 1.05; also discontinuity at 1.05 between local_value (with clamped magnitude? No—local_value uses clamped local_magnitude only when magnitude<=1.05, so clamp irrelevant). Also FP32 evaluation of log formula vs FP64 target: for large |x| (~65504), asinh ~ log(2x); FP32 log/sqrt rounding error could exceed 1e-6 relative → absolute error ~ asinh*eps ≈ 11.09*1e-7 ≈ 1.1e-6. That's a strong risk: outer branch at max FP16 65504 gives asinh≈11.09, FP32 rounding alone ~1e-6. Also x.to(float32) exact for FP16, fine. Record description.
